node.title: Re^3: How to differentiate an empty array from an unitialized one?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
it would be incorrect for Perl to consider an uninitialized value to be an empty string

That is quite incorrect. Perl's [doc://undef] (the default value for uninitialized scalars) evaluates to an empty string (or zero in numeric context). If [doc://warnings] are enabled, this will usually warn, but only to indicate that the programmer may have made a mistake, not because it's inherently wrong.
